title: Feature Request: Allow generation of Formatter for a type in a referenced assembly
intent: A project that references MessagePack can have the source generator emit a formatter for a type declared in a referenced assembly that does not.

functional.text: A [GeneratedMessagePackFormatter] attribute exists that can be placed on a partial class implementing IMessagePackFormatter<T>.
The source generator emits the formatter implementation for T inside the project that declares the partial class.
T may be declared in a referenced assembly that has no reference to MessagePack.

nonFunctional.text: Existing formatter attributes and generated output for types in the same project keep working (inferred)

derivedFrom.note: Derived by the evidence lane from the upstream issue text on 2026-11-13; not Tieto's requirements set.
